retrievalProfile.description: A low-contrast, black-and-white portrait featuring a male subject with textured curly hair and a direct, intimate gaze against a soft-focus draped background.
triggerTerms: soft black and white male headshot
excludeWhen: sharp digital commercial look is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up portrait in monochrome with a muted tonal range. The subject features dense, dark curly hair and light stubble, looking directly at the lens. The lighting is diffused, creating soft transitions between highlights and shadows on the skin. The background consists of out-of-focus vertical drapes with subtle linear markings, providing a shallow depth of field that isolates the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark, high-contrast texture of the hair against the mid-tone skin
The direct eye contact creating an intimate connection with the viewer
The soft, diffused light minimizing harsh shadows on the facial features
The verticality of the background drapes echoing the subject's upright posture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium-close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the bridge of the nose serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's gaze, moves upward to the textured hair, and then down to the shoulders and subtle tattoos.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the frame is occupied by the soft-focus background, providing breathing room above the head.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft whites (specular highlights on skin and eyes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; value range is compressed to avoid harsh whites or absolute blacks, favoring a silvery, filmic quality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome, medium-close-up portrait of a man with dark curly hair and light stubble, looking directly at the camera. Use soft, diffused lighting and a shallow depth of field against a draped, out-of-focus background. Apply a fine film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, thin-weight serif or sans-serif font in a muted gray to maintain the intimate, analog aesthetic.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting soft and diffused without harsh shadows?
Is the hair texture clearly defined against the skin?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to isolate the subject?

mustRedesign: Ensure the hair does not lose detail in the shadows
Maintain a soft, non-digital skin texture

mustAchieve: Natural skin texture with visible pores and stubble
avoid: Pure white highlights that lose detail

postGenerationChecks: Verify the eyes have subtle catchlights
Ensure the monochrome conversion is balanced across the mid-tones
Confirm the film grain is uniform and not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome + Soft Diffused Lighting + Shallow Depth of Field + Textured Curly Hair + Direct Gaze
